units.source_text: 不知道我是什么命运，出生的时候白发苍苍。

en.t: I do not know what fate made me this way, but when I was born my hair was already completely white.

units.source_text: 此后越来越年轻，现在变成这么个娃娃相了。

en.t: After that I grew younger and younger, and now I have turned into this childlike face.

units.source_text: 但是计算一下年龄嘛，没出生以前算是六十岁，加上去说不定现在有一百十五六岁啦。”

en.t: But if you calculate my age, counting me as sixty before I was born and adding the years since, I may well be about a hundred and fifteen or sixteen now.
